# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects any active spell or item from the Essence realm. Caster can
concentrate on a 5' radius area each round.
@@ 2
As Detect Essence, except the realm is Mentalism.
@@ 3
As Detect Essence, except the realm is Channeling.
@@ 5
As Detect Essence, except detects invisible things. All attacks against
something so detected receive a special modification of -50.
@@ 6
As Detect Essence, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap
sophistication may modify this chance).
@@ 7
As Detect Essence, except detects if a being is evil or an item created by
evil or long used by a very evil person.
@@ 8
Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the
caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.
@@ 10
As Detect Essence, except it will give an estimate of the power of the person
(level) or item or spell examined.
@@ 11
As Detect Essence, except detects dead bodies and whether anything has died in
the radius in the last 24 hours.
@@ 12
As Location I, except range is 300'.
@@ 15
As Detect Essence, except detects any spell that has been cast in the area
examined. Gives exact spell that was cast.
@@ 16
As Location I, except range is 500'.
@@ 18
As Perceive Power I, except range is 300'.
@@ 20
As Location I, except range is 1 mile.
@@ 25
As Detect Essence, except detects any type of detection spell that is
operating in the area examined (gives exact spell detected).
@@ 30
Any of the lower level Detect spells can be used once per round.
@@ 50
As Location I, except range is 1 mile per level.
